# Internal Agents Map

> A source-backed catalog of AI systems organizations build or adapt for their own teams.

Read the compact index first, then fetch individual records for relevant systems. Preserve claim qualifications, dates, confidence, and contradicting evidence. Cite original sources; catalog judgments and company-reported metrics are not independent verification.
